game_start.intro: Tšhupetšo e thoma. Suthi ya go phura: {trump_suit} (karete ya go phura: {trump_str}).
game_start.no_trump_card: ga go na le e tee

player_prompt.intro:
O mmopi {player_id} mo papadi ya German Whist.
{phase_info}
O na le {hand_size} di karte.
Bana karte ka '[play N]', moo N ke saeti sa yona mo matšatšing a gago (bjalo ka '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: KAROLO YA GO ITHUTA: Mofenyi wa moano o mongwe le o mongwe o tšea karata e bulegilego gomme yo a lahlegetšwego o goga karata ye latelago go tšwa mokotleng. Mekgwa yeo e fihleletšwego ka nako ye ga e tšeelwe hlogong ya phenyo.
player_prompt.phase_playing: KGWETHEGO YA GO BOELELA: Mokgobo o feditšwe. Mogato o mongwe le o mongwe go tloga ga bjale go ya pele o tla thuša gore re fenye.

next_card.playing_phase: Ga go na karata yeo e newago - karolo ya papadi e thomile.
next_card.deck_empty: Mokgobo ga o na selo - go ka se be le karata yeo e newago.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopego sa mosepelo se sego molaong. Diriša '[play N]' go bapala karata ya Nth ka seatleng sa gago.
invalid_move.bad_position: Boemo bjoo bja karata ga bo gona. O swara dikarata tša {hand_size} .
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: O swanetše go latela mohlala wa gagwe gomme o bapale ka karata ya {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Karata yeo e ka se ke ya dirišwa.

game_action.played: Sebapadi {player_id} se ile sa bapala ka {card}.

trick.won: Sebapadi {winner_id} se thopa papadi ka go diriša {card}.
trick.won_learning: Mmopi {winner_id} a tsena le trick ka {card} a tsenya le karte ya go bonagala

phase.learning_complete: Karolo ya go ithuta e fedile - leano le lengwe le le lengwe leo le šetšego ke la bohlokwa bakeng sa phenyo.

draw.winner_received: O fentše papadi gomme wa amogela {card}.
draw.loser_received: O lahlegetšwe ke papadi gomme wa ntšha {card} ka mokotleng.
draw.winner_preview: Karata e latelago yeo go bolelwago ka yona ke {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Tricks tša go tsena tša kgolo - Mmopi 0: {tricks0}, Mmopi 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Tshepedišo: {phase} ({remaining_cards} di karte tša kgauswi mo dek)

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Ga go na dikarata tšeo di lego ka seatleng sa gago.

trick_view.empty: Ga go na dikarata tšeo di ilego tša bapala leano leo.

outcome.summary: Kgaolo ya go ithuta - Mothodi 0: {l0}, Mothodi 1: {l1}. Kgaolo ya go bapala - Mothodi 0: {p0}, Mothodi 1: {p1}. Mothodi {winner_id} o hlola ka {winner_tricks} dikgwebo tša go bala!
